name: Are weather-resistant metal roofs noisy during hailstorms or heavy rain?

mainEntity.name: Are weather-resistant metal roofs noisy during hailstorms or heavy rain?

acceptedAnswer.text: Modern weather-resistant metal roofs, especially when installed correctly with proper sheathing and insulation, are not significantly noisier than other roofing materials during hailstorms or heavy rain. The sound-dampening properties of the roof deck and attic insulation play a crucial role. A practical tradeoff to consider is selecting a roofing system with integrated sound-dampening layers or ensuring adequate attic insulation during your roof replacement project to mitigate potential noise.
acceptedAnswer.description: No, modern metal roofs with proper insulation are not significantly noisier in bad weather. Proper sheathing and attic insulation help dampen sound.
